data.title: Aurania Terminates Private Placement, Announces CEO Loan and Proposed Warrant Extension
data.description:
The latest update is out from Aurania Resources ( (TSE:ARU) ).

Aurania Resources is a mineral exploration company focused on identifying, evaluating, acquiring and exploring mineral properties, particularly precious metals and critical energy in Europe and abroad. The company terminated its previously announced non-brokered private placement because of current market conditions.

Chairman, President and CEO Keith Barron agreed to provide an unsecured loan of up to US$1.5 million at 2% annual interest, with advances made as agreed and repayment due 12 months and one day after demand. The proceeds are for exploration expenses and general working capital.

Aurania also applied to extend 3,747,243 warrants by 12 months, with an exercise price of C$0.75, subject to TSXV acceptance; the warrants were issued in December 2024 and otherwise retain their terms. The loan and proposed extension are related-party transactions, with exemptions from certain MI 61-101 valuation and shareholder-approval requirements; independent directors approved both.

data.title: CSN Board Elects Mario Augusto da Silva as CFO and Investor Relations Executive Officer
data.description:
Companhia Siderurgica Nacional ( (BR:CSNA3) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional (CSN) is a publicly held company. Its Board of Directors elected Mario Augusto da Silva as chief financial officer and Investor Relations Executive Officer; he will take office on December 1, 2026, succeeding interim officeholders Fabio Schvartsman and Pedro Barros Mercadante Oliva.

Silva has more than 25 years of executive, board and consulting experience, including roles as CEO of Cosan and CFO of Braskem, as well as board positions at several companies. His career includes financial and strategic transactions, along with debt and equity deals in local and international capital markets.

data.title: Brava Starts Production at PPT-53 Well in Papa-Terra Field
data.description:
Brava Energia ( (BR:BRAV3) ) has provided an announcement.

Production started at the PPT-53 well in the Papa-Terra Field after authorization from Ibama. The campaign now has two of four planned new wells in operation, significantly reducing project execution risk.

With the Papa-Terra phase completed, the campaign moves forward in Atlanta. The Lone Star rig began drilling the ATL-9H and ATL-10H wells in early November.

data.title: AXIA Energia Board Approves R$6 Billion PNC Share Redemption
data.description:
An announcement from Centrais Eletricas Brasileiras SA-Eletrobras ( (BR:AXIA3) ) is now available.

AXIA Energia’s board approved the redemption of 129,982,668 Class C preferred shares, valued at R$6.0 billion and representing 49.91% of the remaining shares in that class. The redemption value is R$46.16 per share, based on the closing price of the company’s common shares on November 25, 2026.

Shareholders who do not elect conversion will be automatically redeemed, while PNC holders may convert all or part of eligible shares into common shares at a one-for-one ratio during December 3-7, 2026. ADR holders cannot elect conversion and will have the underlying PNC shares mandatorily redeemed, with proceeds transferred by Citibank N.A.

data.title: AFC reports lower revenue and reduced interim loss
data.description:
AFC Group Holdings Limited ( (NZ:AFC) ) has provided an update.

AFC Group Holdings Limited’s reported revenue comes from cosmetic and wine products, and its businesses include biotechnology manufacturing. Longview Estate maintained vineyard and wine inventories, while AFC Biotechnology Manufacture Co Limited generated limited sales from existing stock and had largely unutilised manufacturing capacity before ceasing operations after the period end.

For the six months ended 30 September 2026, operating revenue was NZ$19,723, down from NZ$33,053, and the net loss was NZ$282,476, compared with NZ$363,640 a year earlier. The group had net liabilities of NZ$76,086, current liabilities exceeding current assets, and a disclosed material uncertainty related to going concern; no dividend was proposed.

data.title: Torrent Capital Reports Preliminary October NAV and Portfolio Update
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Torrent Capital Ltd ( (TSE:TORR) ).

Torrent Capital reported preliminary, unaudited October 2026 results showing estimated NAV of approximately $26.3 million, or $0.69 per share, as of October 31, compared with approximately $28.6 million, or $0.75 per share, as of September 30. Management said October market weakness, which persisted into November, weighed on portfolio valuations. The October financial information is preliminary and unaudited and remains subject to change following the company’s standard closing procedures and review.

data.title: Abcourt Reports First-Quarter Results With C$7.0 Million Gold Revenue
data.description:
Abcourt Mines ( (TSE:ABI) ) has shared an update.

Abcourt Mines, a Canadian gold company developing the Sleeping Giant mine and mill and exploring its Flordin property in northwestern Quebec, reported first-quarter results for the period ended September 30, 2026. It sold 1,155 ounces of gold at an average realized price of C$5,848 per ounce, generating C$7.0 million in revenue, compared with no revenue in the year-earlier quarter.

Costs of sales were C$16.8 million and net loss was C$13.2 million, compared with a C$7.5 million loss in the prior-year quarter. Abcourt increased its Glencore senior secured debenture to US$40 million, had drawn US$38 million by September 30, and repaid its Nebari facility in full in September; cash was C$1.4 million and working capital was C$1.9 million at quarter-end.
